title: Maha Strategies Enterprise MCP Gateway - first release contract
transport: JSON MCP messages over HTTPS POST

authorization.tenantBinding: The credential and registered server must belong to the same client tenant.

registration.toolCallRule: tools/call additionally requires an explicit allowedToolNames allowlist.

contextPackAdmission.operatorConfiguration: contextPackRequiredTools is a subset of a server's allowedToolNames.
contextPackAdmission.verification: The gateway requires a tenant-owned registered pack and verifies sha256(context) equals contextPackHash and the stored output hash.
contextPackAdmission.retention: The gateway event stores the pack ID and outcome, not the context.
